g.text: Autonomous & Grounded Educational Tutoring • Model Context Protocol • Multi-LLM Orchestration
User uploads textbook photos, PDFs, Word docs,
or records audio queries in English / Swahili / Luganda
Learner reviews extracted OCR text, fixes handwriting
mistakes, and confirms target output language
Learner plays generated 5-question test, receives score,
edits notes, and explicitly approves saving to cloud
★ Zero unverified writes — Complete human validation
• Injects strict context boundary: Uses ONLY uploaded sources [1], [2]
• Anti-Hallucination: Kindly declines to answer if concepts are not in notes
• mode: 'ask' ➔ Grounded Q&A answering learner doubts with citations [1]
• mode: 'summary' ➔ 4-5 bullet points + 3 core vocabulary definitions
• mode: 'guide' ➔ 4 key concepts, detailed explanations & self-test questions
• mode: 'lesson' ➔ Synthesizes strict JSON schema for 5-question interactive quizzes
• Smart timeout catchers, rate-limit monitors, and automatic cascade
• Response returns 'X-AI-Provider' HTTP header for transparency
Cascade: Gemini ➔ Groq ➔ OpenRouter ➔ Mistral ➔ Heuristic Fallback
Fast multimodal context, strong instruction following & cost efficiency
Ultra-low token latency (300+ tps) for near-instant tutoring & quiz creation
Multi-endpoint fallback when primary provider limits or quotas are exceeded
Tier 4: Mistral / Fireworks / NVIDIA NIM / Cohere
Redundant geographic cluster ensuring constant service availability
Zero-connectivity deterministic summary & question generator in TypeScript
Spawns Node.js stdio subprocess on session start
• Resolves relative paths, web URLs & base64
Allows external dev agents to run OCR on student files
• Active note draft buffer, prompt options, current audio blob
Ephemeral; bound to user session and active lesson player
• Zustand Store: Local streaks, XP points, coin wallet balance
• Dexie IndexedDB: Full-text cached study sources, offline notes & draft edits
• Collections: users, learner_profiles, notes, progress, transactions
• Stores original uploaded document files (PDFs, docx, camera photos)
• Regional East African Speech-to-Text (STT) trained on regional accents
• Regional Text-to-Speech (TTS) audio synthesis in Swahili and Luganda
• Primary cloud OCR extraction with automated secondary key failover
• Tesseract.js WebAssembly fallback when cloud is unavailable
• Mammoth: Extracts raw text & hierarchy from Word documents (.docx)
• PDF-Parse: Fast server-side extraction from curriculum syllabus PDFs
• Learner identity, passwordless logins & session tokens
• Server-side route validation via Next.js 16 proxy.ts
